summary: Beech 58TC N6748V (CEN22FA011) departed Blake Field (Delta) for Rock Springs, WY; lost radar contact over Grand Mesa near Castle Peak; wreckage found near Jerry Creek Reservoir; sole occupant deceased.
location: near Jerry Creek Reservoir, Grand Mesa (near Castle Peak)
responding_agency: Mesa County Sheriff's Office, Mesa County Search and Rescue, Plateau Valley Fire District, Colorado State Patrol, Civil Air Patrol, Careflight, Lumen helicopter
notes: Crash date per NTSB factual report CEN22FA011 (Oct 11, 2021, 0857 MDT); remote crash site reached by Lumen helicopter crews.
